_note: Rainbow spectrum and glitter looks (Lib/Rainbow), used when the caller's opts leave a value out. Saturation and value 0 to 1; scales are factors of the caller's sparkle texture.

spectrum._note: strip_px: source pixels per tinted strip; cycles: hue turns across the span; sat and val: the tint's saturation and value

glitter._note: at most max sparkles at once; a sparkle's scale is scale_min plus up to scale_range more, at random, and it starts turned up to rot_range_deg
